prompt:
Design the machine-checkable architecture for the new chi02 workload capacity block that will join the existing VCF fleet without changing its management domain. The requirements and current component inventory are in testdata/estate.json. The block must run at one site, place two hosts in each of four racks, survive loss of any one rack (two hosts), and still provide at least 360 physical cores and 6144 GiB RAM after that loss. It must provide at least 240 TiB usable storage with failuresToTolerate set to 2; use eight identical hosts, each with 64 physical cores, 1024 GiB RAM, and 64 TiB raw storage, and use the fixture's 0.50 usable-storage ratio. Keep all workload data in chi02, do not stretch the cluster, and keep measured latency to the chi01 management domain within the stated 5 ms limit. Use the VLANs, subnets, DNS, NTP, names, and addressing from the fixture, with separate MANAGEMENT, VMOTION, VSAN, and NSX_HOST_TEP networks.

Before implementing the design, use the harness's real network research tools to consult live, reachable Broadcom compatibility/interoperability and upgrade-path publications for VCF 9.1. Record the Broadcom sources you actually consulted and the relevant facts in the artifact's research array. Do not treat the local compatibility snapshot as a substitute for this live research. Live publications can change, so testdata/compatibility-9.1.0.json is the pinned grading authority for supported source-to-target transitions, required gates, and ordering.

Complete the Go package in architecture/model.go and create architecture/design.json. Build must return the same design represented by that JSON artifact. The sddcSpec member must be a greenfield VCF 9.1 SddcSpec with workflowType VCF_EXTEND, eight new hosts, a new vCenter, a new three-node NSX manager cluster, the required networks, and vSAN FTT=2. It must validate against components.schemas.SddcSpec in specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json, pinned from tag 9.1.0.0 of vmware/vcf-api-specs. Use conspicuous non-secret replacement strings for required password fields. The migrationPlan member must validate against schemas/migration-plan.schema.json and contain exactly one ordered step for every inventory component, naming its current component and version, target component and version, action, and all gates required by the pinned compatibility snapshot. Preserve the management-domain no-change boundary. Include table-driven Go tests, and make the complete repository pass the provided race-enabled verifier. Deliver code and the JSON architecture artifact, not a prose report.
